crossRefs.note: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.
You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.
He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

translations.web: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
translations.bsb: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other
translations.asv: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four feet thereof; and two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.
